title: Bg Data Table
body: When a bad reading is flagged in the Bg Data Table, would it be possible to turn the dots on the main screen graph a different color?  This would make bad readings be differentiated from valid ones.

comments.body: BTW: How do you flag a BG reading as bad? Manually, by changing the entry in the SQlite DB?
You mark it as bad in the Bg Data  Table (readings). This is still a feature request, and one that I don't imagine would be too difficult to institute.
If leaving post here can speed up realization of this FR, then I leave it here.

@ARkaine2 This feature was added more than a year ago.  
Do you have a question about it or does it not work for you or what?

**@Navid200**

Sometimes I get "jumping" BG Data (Reading) and it makes main view vertically narrow.
(at screen BG Data point is made white by "disabling" it in BG Data menu).

I'd like to fix vertically narrow view.

The most logic way I see is to remove certain BG Data (Reading).
But is(n't) it possible?

@ARkaine2 That was never the request.  It was to change the color.
But, your idea is interesting.
If I were you, I would open a discussions (not an issue), and we can talk about it.
I will already go ahead and ask to see what the others think about it.  Thanks
@ARkaine2 There is already an open issue for this.  You can add your suggestions there:  https://github.com/NightscoutFoundation/xDrip/issues/2173

[Navid200](https://github.com/Navid200)
So, should I use (enable) time buttons to "force the x axis range"?
Of course I'll try, but ATM it's difficult (not possible) to see/get jump BG Data (Reading).
I'm all interested, or NVM, then I see it later.
@ARkaine2 Unless I am misunderstanding you, this is not related to the x axis.  It is related to the y axis.  And there is nothing you can do about it as is.
